problems: Cliopatria has no row for any of these 13 states, so every keyframe is new (verdict adjust) and no area could be checked against Cliopatria; infobox areas were compared where a page gave one (Siena 8,000 km2 vs 7,840 on the gazetteer; Ferrara 1,100 vs 1,134; Urbino 5,556 vs about 3,300; Presidi 300 vs about 430).

Most Wikipedia pages for these states give dates but no boundaries, so regions are province or radius readings (confidence 2) and extents between dated events are bridges (confidence 1, listed in each dossier's notes).

The Venice ledger (eu-13-c) and the Papal States ledger (eu-13-d) already use counterparts duchy-of-ferrara, scaliger-lordship-of-verona and carrara-lordship-of-padua; the dossiers now exist under those slugs. Florence's counterpart string 'Republic of Siena in Montalcino' matches the new slug republic-of-siena-in-montalcino.
Two WebFetch URLs failed (War_of_Siena, War_of_Ferrara disambiguation); the war pages were replaced by Italian_War_of_1551-1559 and War_of_Ferrara_(1482-1484).

Colony-type dossiers (viceroyalty-of-naples, state-of-the-presidi, state-of-milan) need matching vassal_start/vassal_end events in kingdom-of-spain, crown-of-aragon and habsburg-monarchy with these slugs as counterparts; check for double drawing with the Habsburg Monarchy Cliopatria shapes (1714-1734 Naples, 1714-1796 Milan, Mantua after 1708).

duchy-of-mantua draws Montferrat as a vassal 1536-1708 (personal union), while marquisate-of-montferrat keeps its own life 967-1708; the Montferrat gazetteer region is Alessandria + Asti provinces plus Trino and Alba circles.

Page-budget note: each dossier used 1-5 pages (Siena 5, Ferrara 5, Montferrat 3, Mantua 5, Lordship of Milan 5, Verona 4, Padua 4, Naples 2, Presidi 2, Lucca 2, Urbino 2, Milan 1, Montalcino 4 shared); the group's 6-10 most important states were written, the rest are listed under gaps.
